design: a5_en_concrete plus broader synonym coverage in the answer_style polarity anchors
language: english-only anchors; candidates may be english or chinese

answer_style.text: writing and answering style preference: prose, wording, verbosity, concision, and organization of notes and answers
I prefer concise, brief, direct answers and notes that lead with the main point, core message, or takeaway
I no longer want meandering, verbose, roundabout prose, wording, or unnecessary preamble and background
I switched my answer style from long, detailed explanations to short, point-first summaries

beverage.text: beverage or drink preference such as coffee, tea, juice, soda, or water
I prefer choosing a beverage to drink
I no longer choose or consume a beverage
I changed my beverage preference from one drink to another

color.text: color, hue, tint, and visual design preference such as blue, green, amber, or pastel tones
I prefer choosing a color for appearance or design
I no longer want or use a color in the design
I changed my color preference from one hue to another

food.text: food, dish, and eating preference such as noodles, dumplings, barbecue, or salad
I prefer eating a particular food or dish
I no longer want to eat or choose a food
I changed my food preference from one dish to another

music.text: music listening, composition, and performance preference such as jazz, rock, classical, or pop
I prefer listening to or performing a kind of music
I no longer want to listen to or perform a kind of music
I changed my music preference from one style to another

programming_language.text: programming language, source code, and software development such as Python, JavaScript, Rust, or Go
I prefer using a programming language to write and run software
I no longer use or prefer a programming language for code
I switched from one programming language to another for coding

sport.text: sport, exercise, and physical activity preference such as running, swimming, climbing, or yoga
I prefer doing a sport or training activity
I quit or avoid a sport or physical activity
I changed my sport preference from one activity to another
